major_cooldowns.name: Ebon Might
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Recast it whenever only a few seconds remain so the pandemic window adds the leftover duration onto the new cast, and hold your resource-spenders until it is active.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 395152 is the cast id (5/5 parses); the matching self aura for uptime tracking is 395296.

major_cooldowns.name: Breath of Eons
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on a short, safe flight path roughly on cooldown, but shift the timing to land its 10 second window on your buffed allies' own burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it essentially on cooldown, pairing it with a Max Rank Fire Breath by default, or with Upheaval when the extra radius matters; cancel the buff with a macro if no empower is ready so its own cooldown can start.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at Max Rank when that will not delay Upheaval or let Ebon Might or Duplicate expire early, otherwise drop to Rank 1 and keep spending resources.

major_cooldowns.name: Upheaval
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at Rank 1 in single target, and only raise its rank when the wider radius is needed to hit more enemies.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 396286 is the cast id observed in top parses (5/5); the guide's text also cites 408092 for this ability, which was not observed casting in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Skip
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it first in the opener right after your initial Fire Breath and Upheaval, then roughly on cooldown, timed so it takes the full cooldown reduction off Fire Breath, Upheaval, Prescience, and Breath of Eons.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 404977 is the cast id (5/5 parses); only taken over Interwoven Threads.

rule.description: Keep Ebon Might up on yourself
rule.action: Recast Ebon Might before it falls off, ideally with only a few seconds left, so the group buff never lapses.

rule.description: Fire Breath only while Ebon Might is up
rule.action: Hold Fire Breath until Ebon Might is active so the cast extends its duration; spend the downtime rebuilding resources instead.

rule.description: Upheaval only while Ebon Might is up
rule.action: Wait for Ebon Might to be active before empowering Upheaval, and build resources while the buff is down.

rule.description: Spend Essence Burst before it caps
rule.action: Fire off an Eruption to spend Essence Burst before casting another generator like Prescience or Living Flame caps it at 2 stacks.

rule.description: Open with Prescience, Tip the Scales, empowers
rule.action: Apply Prescience to your buff targets before pressing Tip the Scales into a Max Rank Fire Breath and then Upheaval.
